dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the dorsal midline and right flank, characterized by sharp, high-contrast outer perimeters of light grey pixels transitioning into darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Significant clusters of high-intensity white blobs are localized on the mid-right lateral surface and the anterior neck area, appearing as dense, non-gradient pixel concentrations.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of three prominent annuli on the upper right flank; a secondary trapezoidal relationship exists between four high-intensity blobs located near the posterior dorsal region.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, elongated, irregularly-shaped light patch is located on the mid-left flank, distinct from the smaller circular annuli.
